01 β

Transition probability calculator

Continuous-time Markov models

JC69 models A, C, G and T with equal frequencies and equal substitution rates.

This calculator is separate from the methylation beta-value tree. Do not interpret beta-value distance directly as nucleotide substitutions per site.

JC69 transition probabilities

At evolutionary distance d = 0.10

Same state90.64%
Any different nucleotide9.36%
Each specific change (for example A → G) 3.12%
Model equation P(same) = ¼ + ¾e−4d/3

03

Transparent by design

No data leaves the browser. The pipeline validates beta values, imputes missing loci by row median, selects loci by variance, calculates pairwise sample distances, and applies average-linkage UPGMA clustering.
